Thanks Samantha — got the W-9 and bank letter, appreciate the quick turnaround. Looping in procurement (Marissa) for PO mapping and Finance for activation.

To confirm Redwood's requirements:
- Remittance format: we prefer a single reference field that contains PO|INV — e.g., PO12345|INV-67890. That lets our AP auto-apply payments to invoices.
- Primary payment method: ACH (US domestic). We do accept wires for one-off exceptions; provide wire routing if you need that enabled.
- Micro-deposit: Finance will send two small ACH deposits (under $0.50). Reply with the amounts or a screenshot of the deposit confirmation once you see them and we'll move to active status.

Action items:
1) Marissa — can you confirm the PO labeling we should expect from our procurement system and any additional vendor fields we need to capture?
2) Samantha — once micro-deposits are verified, please reply with the screenshot (microdeposit-proof.png) and note which account name they were applied to.

Next steps: Finance typically completes activation within 2 business days after micro-deposit verification. Once active, our first remittance will use the reference format above.

Thanks,
Elliot Price
